about.headline: Full-Stack Developer Shipping Across Web2, AI, and Web3
about.deck: Abhijeet Kakade is focused mostly on web2 products today, with hands-on work in AI tooling and selective Web3 systems where they actually fit.
about.byline: By Our Digital Correspondent · Nashik Bureau
body: Abhijeet Kakade is a full-stack developer focused primarily on web2 products, scalable frontend systems, and practical AI integrations.
Earlier work in autonomous agents and gasless Web3 experiences helped shape his technical base, but the current focus is broader product engineering and tools people actually use.
My mission is to build fast, useful software that solves real problems without unnecessary complexity.

projects.title: AvaAgent
projects.impact: Local-first programmable Avalanche wallet layer for terminal, code, and Codex.
projects.description: A comprehensive toolkit for Avalanche developers, providing a local-first wallet experience with CLI, SDK, and Codex integration.
features: Multi-Interface: Accessible via CLI (avaagent), JS SDK, and Codex plugin with MCP server.
Secure Local Wallet: Creates and encrypts wallets locally for maximum privacy and control.
DeFi Integration: Quotes and executes swaps on Avalanche through 0x Protocol.
Codex Native: Exposes wallet actions to Codex through high-performance plugin tools.
Programmable Transfers: Native support for AVAX and token transfers via terminal or code.

projects.title: MotionSplit
projects.techStack: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, ffmpeg.wasm, JSZip, Framer Motion, GSAP, Vite PWA
projects.impact: Local video-to-frame extraction without ads, low-quality compression, or uploads.
projects.description: Built MotionSplit as a personal tool after running into ad-heavy, low-quality video-to-image converters. It extracts clean frames in the browser so those images can be reused quickly while creating content and websites.
features: Browser-Local Processing: Uses ffmpeg.wasm so the source video stays on the device.
Precise Extraction Controls: Export every frame or sample by FPS with custom start/end range.
Clean Output: Download PNG or JPG sequences as a single ZIP without quality-killing online compression.
Builder Utility: Made to speed up content and website creation when still frames are needed fast.

projects.title: FlowDrop
projects.techStack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Hono, D1, Durable Objects, WebSockets
projects.impact: Quick cross-device handoff for your own devices without account friction.
projects.description: Built FlowDrop to solve the daily problem of moving text, images, and files across devices. It is a Chrome-first sharing tool for fast transfers between your own devices over the internet.
features: Zero-Account Pairing: Connect devices with a simple OTP instead of email, chat apps, or sign-in flows.
Live Session Handoff: Designed for quick transfer of copied text, links, images, and files across devices.
Ephemeral by Default: Temporary sessions keep the tool focused on handoff, not long-term storage.
Cloudflare-Native Realtime Stack: Uses Workers, Durable Objects, D1, and WebSockets for fast sync.

projects.title: AVAXVERSE
projects.techStack: Next.js (React 19), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Solidity, Avalanche, Wagmi
projects.impact: High-fidelity DID & Reputation System for 10k+ potential nodes.
projects.description: A decentralized super app and trust protocol for the Avalanche ecosystem, revolutionizing the freelance economy with trustless identity and reputation systems.
features: Identity Registry (DID): Decentralized ID system for verifiable user profiles.
Reputation Token (SBT): Soulbound Tokens representing immutable user credibility.
Escrow Protocol: Secure, trustless payments for decentralized freelance services.
Professional Court: Community-driven juror system for resolving on-chain disputes.
Reputation-Weighted Voting: Governance power scaled by contribution and credibility.

projects.title: OnlyPngs
projects.impact: Winner of 2:47PM Studio Hackathon — Pioneer in gasless Agent UX.
projects.description: An AI-powered, non-custodial NFT trading platform enabling automated, gasless transactions. Winner of 2:47PM Studio Hackathon.
features: The Sleeping Buy: Autonomous monitoring system that executes trades based on price alerts while offline.
Gasless UI/UX: Completely gas-free experience via 0xgasless Paymaster-funded transactions.
Natural Language Interface: Uses Gemini 2.0 to translate human intent into on-chain actions.
Security First: Architected using Smart Accounts and session keys for non-custodial control.

5-Stage Pipeline: Static, Symbol, Diff Isolation, AI-Critic, and Supervise stages for thorough analysis.
Kyoto Night Aesthetic: Custom terminal theme with Sakura Pink, Matcha Green, and Wisteria Purple.
